correctness.rationale: For complex BMO boundary data f, Poisson Fatou limits simultaneously for f and |f|² imply Phi_f(z) tends to zero in every fixed non-tangential cone at almost every ζ. The analytic Blaschke disk automorphism b_a has exact Poisson variance 1-|b_a(z)|² and norm one; h_a=b_a-a belongs to VMOA and locally tends to zero as a=rζ→ζ. A pseudohyperbolic high-variance disk lies in a shrinking Stolz cone; inside it Phi_f vanishes and outside the automorphism variance is uniformly small as cutoff tends to one. L2 triangle upper bounds and tests at fixed interior z and at z=a yield the max-law for every fixed c. Choosing c=±1 rules out strongly extreme unit vectors in BMO, BMOA, VMO and VMOA modulo constants; interior points are not extreme either. This proof uses classical Fatou and exact Möbius identities, not finite computation.
